Official Agricultural Agreement

Terms & Conditions & Quality Guarantee

These terms govern commercial feed purchases, farmgate haulage delivery, batch quality guarantees, and animal ration advisory services provided by NutriAgro Feeds™.

🧪

1. Feed Quality, Formulations & Aflatoxin Guarantee

NutriAgro Feeds™ manufactures commercial livestock rations adhering to strict ISO 9001:2015 milling standards and Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specifications.

  • 100% Aflatoxin Clearance: Every milling run undergoes strict ELISA laboratory screening to ensure total aflatoxin levels remain well below 20 ppb (parts per billion), protecting herd health and milk safety.
  • Certified Guaranteed Analysis: Each 50kg bag is certified for minimum Crude Protein (CP), Crude Fat, Crude Fiber, Calcium, Phosphorus, and trace mineral chelation as stated on the tag.
  • Tamper-Evident Packaging: Bags are dispatched in heavy-duty HDPE woven sacks with moisture-barrier inner liners and machine-stitched tamper tags.
🛡️ Quality Guarantee: In the unlikely event a bag arrives with broken stitching or water moisture damage incurred during transport, NutriAgro will replace the affected bags free of charge within 48 hours.
🚚

2. Farmgate Freight Delivery & Hauler Access

We operate dedicated agro-hauler trucks (3 MT to 14 MT capacity) to deliver directly to rural farm gates across India.

  • Free Freight Threshold: Orders of 15 bags (750 kg) or more qualify for 100% Free Farmgate Freight Delivery. Orders under 15 bags incur standard distance-based local delivery charges.
  • Truck Access Road: The customer must ensure that the farm approach road allows safe passage for commercial delivery haulers (minimum 10-foot road width and overhead wire clearance).
  • Farmgate Unloading: Hauler drivers will park at the nearest safe vehicular gate. Farm staff/labor must assist with unloading bags into dry farm storage.
  • Delivery Timelines: Standard farmgate arrival is within 24 to 48 hours from order confirmation. Hauler driver contact and live ETA are shared via SMS and WhatsApp.
🐄

3. Animal Nutrition Advisory & Feed Transition Protocol

Livestock rumen biology requires gradual adaptation to new feed formulations to prevent digestive upsets (acidosis or diarrhea).

  • 7-Day Transition Protocol: When switching cattle, poultry, or swine to NutriAgro feeds, mix 25% NutriAgro with 75% previous ration on Days 1-2; 50/50 on Days 3-4; 75/25 on Days 5-6; and 100% from Day 7 onwards.
  • Clean Water Requirement: High-density pelleted feeds require continuous access to fresh, clean drinking water for optimal feed conversion ratio (FCR) and milk synthesis.
  • Advisory Disclaimer: NutriAgro nutritional guidance and the Gemini AI Agronomist provide general herd optimization science. Specific clinical diagnoses remain under the authority of your licensed local veterinary practitioner.
💰

4. Payment Methods, Credit & GST Invoicing

We provide transparent pricing and multiple payment methods tailored to Indian agricultural operations.

  • Payment on Farmgate Delivery: Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), site cheque, or direct NEFT/RTGS bank transfer upon physical bag inspection.
  • Official GST Tax Invoices: All orders are invoiced with applicable GST rates (Animal Feeds are classified under HSN 2309 with Nil/Zero GST exemption for pure compound animal feed in India). Official commercial invoices are generated for all business entities.
  • Commercial Credit Lines: Progressive dairy farms and poultry hatcheries ordering 10+ metric tons monthly may apply for 15-day revolving credit terms subject to verification.
📱

5. WhatsApp & Communication Consent

By creating an account on NutriAgro Feeds, you authorize us to communicate order status and delivery alerts via SMS and WhatsApp:

  • Order logging, dispatch verification, and hauler truck driver details.
  • Seasonal harvest updates, extreme weather ration adjustment alerts, and volume discount vouchers.
  • Your contact details and farm data will never be sold, rented, or shared with third-party marketing companies.
